wikitext: {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Kalos Canyon |characters=カロスキャニオン |japanese=Kalos Canyon |image=Kalos Canyon.png |imagesize=310px |region=Kalos |epicode=XY036 |episode=Battles in the Sky! }} '''Kalos Canyon''' (Japanese: '''カロスキャニオン''' ''Kalos Canyon'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]]. It is located in {{rt|11|Kalos}}, between [[Geosenge Town]] and [[Shalour City]]. It was formed naturally over the course of tens of thousands of years. The winds blowing through the ravines in the canyon turn into rising air currents, and as such it is an ideal spot for [[Sky Battle]]s. There is a center nearby specially for Sky Battles, where {{pkmn|Trainer}}s can rent Sky Battle wing suits and practice in air tubes. The actual Sky Battles are held over the canyon. In ''[[XY036|Battles in the Sky!]]'', {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} paid a visit to the {{pkmn|training}} center, where they rented wing suits and enjoyed some practice flying before meeting Sky Battle instructor [[Moria]]. Later, Ash had his first Sky Battle at the canyon against Moria and her {{p|Talonflame}}. He first used his {{AP|Hawlucha}}, but lost. He then used {{p|Fletchling}}, and managed to win when Fletchling [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{AP|Fletchinder}}.
